en.headline: Hongkong Post posts record HK$905 million deficit for 2025-26
en.dek: The postal service recorded its ninth consecutive annual loss as mail volumes fell by a third over five years, with the Postmaster General citing protectionism and rising costs.
body: Hongkong Post reported an operating deficit of HK$905 million for the 2025-26 financial year, its largest on record and the ninth straight year of losses.

In its annual report published on Wednesday, the department said total operating revenue stood at HK$2.333 billion against operating expenditure of HK$3.238 billion. Mail volume fell to 603 million items from 904 million in 2021-22, a cumulative drop of 33.3 per cent.

Postmaster General Donald Ng Man-kit said the emergence of protectionism, tightening customs policies, rising terminal dues and higher operating costs had posed significant challenges. Staff costs accounted for the bulk of expenditure at HK$2.055 billion.

The department is accelerating a shift toward cross-border e-commerce logistics and has expanded its Easy Post+ service to more than 200 destinations. The government is reviewing the operating model for more cost-effective service options.

zh.headline: 香港郵政2025/26年度錄得9.05億元赤字創紀錄
zh.dek: 郵政署年報顯示連續第九年虧蝕，郵件量五年下跌三分之一，署長吳文傑指保護主義及成本上升構成挑戰。
body: 香港郵政公布2025/26財政年度運作赤字達9.05億港元，屬歷來最高，並連續第九年錄得虧損。
周三發表的年報顯示，總營運收入為23.33億港元，總運作開支則達32.38億港元。郵件處理量由2021/22年度的9.04億件跌至6.03億件，五年累計下跌百分之三十三點三。
郵政署長吳文傑表示，保護主義湧現、各地海關政策收緊、終端費上升及營運成本上漲帶來重大挑戰。員工成本佔開支最大部分，達20.55億港元。
部門正加快轉型跨境電商物流，並將「易網遞+」服務擴展至逾200個目的地。政府正全面檢視營運模式，探討更具成本效益的服務方案。
